title: Friendly Ghast Challenge
description: A Plugin that creates the Challange to Kill the Wither by not touching any block and riding ontop of a happy Ghast.
body:
# Goal

Ghast Challenge is a hardcore Minecraft plugin for PaperMC that introduces a unique challenge mode centered around the new Happy Ghast entity. Players can start, stop, and restart the challenge using commands. When the challenge begins, all players are placed on a friendly Happy Ghast and must survive as long as possible without touching the ground or losing their mount. The plugin features a moving rainbow gradient timer in the action bar to display elapsed time, and the challenge ends automatically if a player fails the conditions or when a Wither is killed. Additionally, the plugin provides a command to reset the world safely. All commands and features are designed for multiplayer fun and competitive gameplay.
